description.en:
Place names registry includes about 800 000 place names about nature and culture, their checked spelling, language (Finnish, Swedish, Northern Saami, Inari Saami or  tai Skolt Saami), coordinates, type of location and the position of the language in the local municipality. Spelling has been checked by Research Institute for the Languages of Finland. The coordinates mark the center of the place or in case of rivers the mouth of the river.

The dataset's format has been changed from orginial GML to GeoPackage at CSC. 

Coordinate Reference System: ETRS89 / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067)
